statements.notes: As with any supplement, consult your healthcare practitioner before use, particularly if you are pregnant, nursing, taking medication or have a medical condition.
Note: Product is packaged with a desiccant. Store in a cool, dark, dry place. No refrigeration required.
Collagen protein does not count toward the FDA recommended Percent Daily Value for protein because it lacks one essential amino acid: Tryptophan.
